name: minStrength
label: Minimum Strength
help: Only signals with a strength score at or above this value, 0 to 10. Use 7 for warm, 9 for the strongest.

name: type
label: Signal Type
help: Filter by signal type, for example KEYWORD_SEARCH_COMMENT. Leave empty for all types.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of results to return and work with during one execution cycle.
